mentions.name: Django Control Room (DCR)
mentions.description: This framework lets developers easily create operational tools (panels) inside the Django Admin, with published panels for Redis, caches, Celery, and more. It provides self-hosted alternatives to external services so fewer third-party dependencies are needed, making it easier to build and productionize Django apps. Work in progress includes a base library layer for tools to inherit from, a common design language, and a formalized plugin system.
mentions.problem: Building and productionizing Django apps often requires many external services for operations tooling; DCR addresses this by providing self-hosted alternatives.
mentions.audience: Django developers building and productionizing Django applications
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a framework that lets you easily create tools inside the Django Admin - https://djangocontrolroom.com

I've published several panels under this banner already (tools for redis, caches, celery, etc.); I am currently working on a base library layer for tools to inherit from and to make it easier to create new tools.
